title: Seared tuna steaks
ingredients: 1 tbsp oil, plus more for the pan
Rice and salad or steamed vegetables
steps: Pat tuna dry. Mix soy, oils, and ginger; brush on steaks. Season.
Heat a skillet until very hot. Sear 1–2 minutes per side for rare/medium-rare.
Rest a minute, slice, sprinkle sesame seeds, and serve.
